text:
jordan: Quick sync — planning to merge three PRs together in the 11:00 PT merge window to avoid cross-repo breakage: runtime/helm chart bump, sdk/api header change, console feature-flag rollout. Need approvals from @lee and @priya. Anyone opposed? Links: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/412 https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/789 https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/156. If no objections by 10:45 PT I'll merge.

lee: :eyes: I'll take the sdk PR now, will ping when I'm done or if it needs a rebase.

priya: I can review runtime/helm. Heads up — console e2e failing on pod affinity after the chart bump, pasting the minimal repro commands below:

```
helm upgrade --install runtime infra/runtime-chart --set image.tag=prod-v2.3.1
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/runtime -c runtime | tail -n 50
```

marta: I can't review until ~10:30 PT, but I can approve console once the e2e is green. Can we split console into a canary-only rollout so we don't block runtime+sdk?

jordan: Yep — plan: merge runtime + sdk first, then console as a canary PR pinned to 10% traffic. Will hold console merge until marta approves. @deploy-bot please schedule canary post-merge.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary job for console at +15m after merge. Status: pending.

lee: sdk PR LGTM. Left one tiny nit about header parsing but non-blocking. :shipit:

priya: runtime/helm — fixed the affinity rule in the chart, pushed a patch to the runtime PR, ran e2e locally (quick smoke) and looks good. Approving.

jordan: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — merging runtime and sdk in ~10m. I'll post merge links and the canary schedule once complete.
